window_note: items below span the last ~7 days per symbol; latest 24h items are dated closest to the snapshot time
source: TradingView MCP per-symbol get_news (real publishers, timestamps, links). Alpha Vantage MCP NEWS_SENTIMENT rejects NSE/BSE ticker syntax and was not usable.
selection_note: Symbols were chosen this refresh as: the top 12 matched watchlist symbols by volume multiple, plus the top daily mover in each of the 8 highest-ranked sectors. This is a bounded, disclosed sample for demonstration and depth, not full-universe news coverage — see counts on the News tab.

items.headline: Bombay Burmah share price jumps 9.5% after Rs.249 crore block deal - check details
items.transmission: A large block trade often reflects an ownership/stake change rather than an operating catalyst; the price move reflects supply-demand from the trade, not a fundamental update.

items.headline: BBTC: Q1 FY27 profit reached ₹582.67 crore on revenue of ₹5,088.69 crore, aided by asset sale gains
items.transmission: Profit was boosted by one-off asset-sale gains rather than core operating margin — flows through reported EPS this quarter but isn't necessarily repeatable.

items.headline: Emcure Pharma shares hits 52-week high post USFDA EIR for Gujarat facility
items.transmission: A clean USFDA Establishment Inspection Report removes a regulatory overhang on the Gujarat plant, supporting continuity of US export revenue from that facility.

items.headline: Emcure to double down on complex generics, biosimilars, ARVs, says COO Samit Mehta
items.transmission: Forward-looking strategy commentary from management; no financial figures attached, so revenue/margin impact can't be sized from this alone.

items.headline: Supreme Petrochem Q4 profit jumps 57%, margins improve sharply
items.transmission: Reported margin expansion flows directly into EPS and can support a valuation re-rating if sustained into subsequent quarters.

items.headline: Supreme Petrochem shares rise up to 6% intraday as trading volume spikes
items.transmission: Price/volume move reported without a stated fundamental trigger — treat as a signal to watch, not a confirmed catalyst.

items.headline: IndiaMart stock crashes 5% after Q1 results; brokerages flag continued subscriber decline despite earnings beat
items.transmission: Paying-subscriber count is the core forward revenue driver for IndiaMART's listing model; a declining base signals slowing future revenue even though this quarter's earnings beat.

items.headline: Buy IndiaMart InterMesh; target of Rs 2300: ICICI Securities
items.transmission: Single-broker price target; included to show the conflicting read against the subscriber-decline story above, not as a consensus view.

items.headline: Central Bank Of India Says Bank Unions Announce Strike On Sept 11, Sept 28-30, And Continuous Strike From Oct 26
items.transmission: Extended union strikes disrupt branch operations and loan processing, a near-term operational/cost drag and a negative sentiment signal.

items.headline: PSBs Nearly Double FCNR(B) Fundraising Targets On Strong Overseas Demand
items.transmission: Higher FCNR(B) deposit mobilization gives PSU banks cheaper foreign-currency funding, supportive of margins sector-wide.

items.headline: CASTROLIND: Q2 2026 saw 25% revenue growth and 41% EBITDA rise, with a ₹6.25 interim dividend declared
items.transmission: EBITDA growing faster than revenue implies margin expansion; the declared interim dividend is a direct capital-return signal.

items.headline: Buy Castrol India; target of Rs 230: Motilal Oswal
items.transmission: Single-broker target price; directional but not a consensus estimate.

items.headline: AADHARHFC: AUM up 18% YOY, PAT up 19%, spreads at 5.8%, and 20% growth guidance reaffirmed
items.transmission: AUM and PAT growth with reaffirmed guidance directly support the growth assumptions underlying its valuation.

items.headline: Blackstone-backed Aadhar Housing sees no need to raise capital for four years; bets on smaller towns to sustain growth
items.transmission: No near-term capital raise removes dilution risk; expansion into underpenetrated towns extends the addressable growth runway.

items.headline: Emami approves ₹282-crore share buyback at maximum price of ₹475
items.transmission: A board-approved buyback reduces share count (supporting EPS) and signals management's view that shares are undervalued.

items.headline: EMAMILTD: Strong revenue growth and portfolio diversification offset margin pressures; outlook remains positive
items.transmission: Revenue growth offsets — but does not eliminate — margin pressure from input costs; net effect on profitability is partial.

items.headline: Whirlpool India Q1 Results: Stock falls 5% after operational miss, margins narrow
items.transmission: Margin compression flows directly through to reported profitability and EPS.

items.headline: Reduce Whirlpool of India; target of Rs 730: ICICI Securities
items.transmission: Single-broker downgrade-style call, consistent with the margin-miss narrative above but not independent confirmation of it.

items.headline: IGIL: Q1 FY27 saw 23% revenue and 29% EBITDA growth, with strong momentum across all segments
items.transmission: EBITDA growth outpacing revenue growth implies margin expansion across the certification business.

items.headline: International Gemological Institute (India) Declares Interim Dividend Of 2.55 Rupees Per Share
items.transmission: A declared dividend is a direct, quantifiable capital-return event.

items.headline: Home First Finance Company India Approves Issuance Of NCDs Aggregating 1.50 Billion Rupees
items.transmission: New debt funding supports loan-book growth but modestly increases leverage — a funding decision, not a profitability catalyst by itself.

items.headline: Buy Home First Finance Company; target of Rs 1450: ICICI Securities
items.transmission: Single-broker target; directional sentiment only.

items.headline: Jindal Stainless Enters Technical Assistance Agreement With JFE Steel For Ferritic Grades
items.transmission: A technology-transfer agreement can improve product mix/margins in ferritic stainless over time, but the benefit is long-dated and not immediately quantifiable.

items.headline: Buy Jindal Stainless; target of Rs 867: Prabhudas Lilladher
items.transmission: Single-broker target price.

items.headline: KPRMILL: Q1 FY27 delivered robust revenue and profit growth, with major expansions fully self-funded
items.transmission: Self-funded capacity expansion grows the business without added debt or equity dilution.

items.headline: Neutral KPR Mill; target of Rs 1200: Motilal Oswal
items.transmission: A neutral broker stance — included to avoid one-sided framing.

items.headline: PVR INOX clarifies ₹200 crore kickback report, says preliminary probe found no evidence
items.transmission: A governance allegation followed by a company denial leaves a reputational overhang until any formal probe concludes, even if no financial impact is confirmed.

items.headline: Price Action | Religare Enterprises shares rise 3% as Ashish Dhawan raises stake; PVR INOX gains 2% on buyback approval
items.transmission: Buyback approval supports EPS and signals management confidence, alongside the governance overhang noted above.

items.headline: Jsw Infra Says Port Logistics Unit Receives Loi For Icd At Kudathini, Ballari District, Karnataka
items.transmission: A letter of intent for a new inland container depot expands future logistics throughput capacity, though it is non-binding at this stage.

items.headline: Adani Ports, JSW Infra, Essar Ports Vie For Rs 5,881 Cr Dadri Logistics Hub
items.transmission: A competitive bid for a large logistics asset — optionality only until an outcome is known.

items.headline: Caplin Point Laboratories shares falls 2% post 10 observations from USFDA
items.transmission: USFDA inspection observations create facility-approval/remediation risk that can affect US export revenue until resolved.

items.headline: Caplin Point Lab stock delivers decisive breakout; Axis Direct shares buy range, stop loss, upside and holding period
items.transmission: A purely technical/chart-based call — shown deliberately alongside the USFDA regulatory risk above as a conflicting view, not a fundamental read.

items.headline: Physicswallah shares jump 6% as Motilal Oswal initiates with Buy, sees 66% upside
items.transmission: A single new-coverage broker call with an aggressive target — directional sentiment, not consensus.

items.headline: Lightspeed Venture Partners exits Physicswallah for Rs 550 crore; Goldman Sachs, ICICI Pru MF, Tata AIA Life among 12 buyers
items.transmission: An early VC exit is a supply overhang via block deal, but participation from large institutional buyers is itself a validation signal — cuts both ways.

items.headline: Adani Total Gas Appoints Preyash Jhaveri As Chief Financial Officer Effective Sept 3
items.transmission: A management appointment; typically neutral for near-term financials absent a stated strategy shift.

items.headline: IGL, MGL to Adani Total Gas: City gas distributor stocks rise up to 4%; here's why
items.transmission: A sector-wide move across city-gas distributors suggests a shared regulatory/tariff tailwind rather than an ATGL-specific event.

items.headline: Nuvama favours Venus Pipes, Welspun Corp, APL Apollo as pipe demand recovery nears
items.transmission: A brokerage sector thesis on pipe-demand recovery, which would benefit order books/margins if it plays out — not yet a reported result.

items.headline: Welspun Group market capitalisation doubles in two years to cross ₹1 lakh crore
items.transmission: Descriptive/historical framing rather than a fresh catalyst — included for context, not as a forward signal.

items.headline: Acme Solar Commissions 66.68 MW Solar And 300 Mwh Bess Capacity In Rajasthan
items.transmission: A completed, commissioned capacity addition directly adds to the contracted revenue-generating asset base — concrete rather than proposed.

items.headline: ACME Solar shares jump 5% after HSBC raises target price - Check investment rationale
items.transmission: Single-broker target raise; directional sentiment.
